name: ReactionBar
summary: Emoji reaction row attached to a Comment / ChatBubble / annotation marker. Each reaction is a small chip showing the emoji + tabular count + toggle state. An 'Add reaction' button opens a Popover picker. The user's reaction toggles via tap / Enter.

keyboard: Add+1 (numeric key) - some patterns wire 1-9 to the first nine reactions
rules: Each chip is a button with aria-pressed (true when 'mine').
aria-label spells out the meaning ('Heart, 4 reactions, you reacted').

do: Render counts in tabular-nums so chips stay aligned when values advance.
Mine state: action.selected.bg + selected.border (~12% accent tint) — never solid lime.
Cap visible reactions at 6 — past that collapse to '+N'.
dont: Don't allow more than ~20 distinct reactions on a single object — too much social noise.
Don't paint chips in danger red — even sad emoji belong in neutral chrome.
